concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a round LION CUB with the beginnings of a fern mane, the first stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, crouched low on its little paws, leaning forward, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round head-body with face; 2 curled fern sprout on the head; 3 two fern tufts (ears); 4 three small paws;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round head-body with face: a round chubby lion cub head-body: tawny golden-brown fur, a pale cream muzzle and chin, a small carved light-wood badge shaped like a leaf on the forehead where the old gem was, two big leaf-green eyes (one catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a confident grin with a tiny fang; no stripes, no gem.
2 curled fern sprout on the head: a young fern frond (fiddlehead) growing from the top of the head: a thick dark-green stalk rolling into a tight spiral, with small fern leaflets along it, about the same size and place as the old tuft.
3 two fern tufts (ears): two tufts of dark-green fern fronds sticking out sideways like the old ears (each a bunch of three or four fern leaves with small leaflets along their edges), the same size and place; no stripes, no yellow.
4 three small paws: three tiny stubby tawny paws, each covered over the toes by a brown scaly acorn cap like a little boot.

ATTITUDE: a brave little lion cub ready to pounce: brows angled down, a confident grin with a tiny fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: tawny golden-brown fur with a pale cream muzzle, dark-green fern fronds, a carved light-wood leaf-shaped badge on the forehead, brown scaly acorn caps over the paws, big leaf-green eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: a green body, yellow stripes or green-and-yellow stripes, crystals, gems or diamonds, cyan or turquoise, gold armour or gold frames, thorny vines, feathery wing-shaped ears, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
